subject.title: Sessions panel: sort by last meaningful activity, not just last message

question: Should Sessions ordering use a read-time meaningful-activity projection or persisted activity timestamp fields, and which event classes count as meaningful?
rationale: The source proves the gap, but the permanent choice affects Gateway RPC shape, row storage/write load, child-session rollup semantics, and the UI reason label contract.

options.title: Read-time projection
options.body: Derive meaningful activity and reason from a bounded recent transcript/event tail plus child metadata, then sort UI surfaces by that projected field without rewriting rows for every qualifying event.

options.title: Persisted activity fields
options.body: Add durable `lastEventAt`, `lastMeaningfulActivityAt`, and `lastVisibleConversationAt` fields with tested rollup writes and migration or doctor handling.

options.title: Narrow to discoverability
options.body: Keep ordering on `updatedAt` for now and only improve visible labels/previews in follow-up UI work.

recommendation.title: Read-time projection
recommendation.body: Derive meaningful activity and reason from a bounded recent transcript/event tail plus child metadata, then sort UI surfaces by that projected field without rewriting rows for every qualifying event.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent work by steipete touched the same Control UI session grouping and Gateway row projection surfaces needed for this product decision.
